# finite: check every point of a finite domain

For a claim about finitely many cases, checking all of them is a proof on exactly those cases (**bounded**). The
predicate comes from a file the node lists under `code:` (for proposals, their `checks.py`, stored as
`dag/predicates/<node>.py`), so changing it makes the evidence stale.

<!-- tests:begin (generated by `dagtool readmes`; edit the test docstrings, not this table) -->
| Test | What it checks | A pass grants |
|---|---|---|
| [`finite/exhaustive`](exhaustive.py) | A predicate holds at every point of a stated finite domain. | Bounded: a proof on exactly that domain. |
